analysis_plan.unit: fresh world; both record variants and all four arms remain paired
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 10000 whole-world resamples; descriptive unadjusted 95% percentile intervals
analysis_plan.format: The revision and repeat-control arms have identical user messages and schemas differing only in property order. The two anchor arms retain the original two-field instructions and schemas. Validate actual serialized order and nonempty reasoning in every arm.
analysis_plan.invalid_answers: Retain and stop on any returned schema, order, empty-reasoning, or technical failure; no resampling or continuation.
analysis_plan.interpretation: Compare final accuracy across all paired cases, not a subset conditioned on initial correctness. Initial and final answers may differ; retain every valid contradiction. The order effect includes placement, delay, and prospective schema information, and does not identify a unique internal mechanism. Reasoning text is not evidence of faithful internal computation.
analysis_plan.decision: no scientific pass gate; no outcome-dependent extension

uncertainty: 10,000 whole-world bootstrap resamples, seed 981723; descriptive, unadjusted 95% intervals. The sampling unit is the world, not an API call. The 24 fresh worlds come from one task family and one model; this is not a cross-model replication. Degenerate intervals do not establish certainty or equivalence. Full-plan unscorable bounds are point-estimate bounds, not confidence intervals.
interpretation: The primary comparison uses final-answer accuracy on all planned cases, without selecting cases by initial correctness. A positive repeat-control minus revision effect supports lower final accuracy when reasoning is placed between the two structured answers rather than after both answers, under these interfaces. Initial-answer accuracy is diagnostic: the model sees the entire schema before generating its initial answer, so output order may affect initial answers as well. Correct-to-wrong changes describe visible within-response revisions, but neither those changes nor the primary comparison uniquely identifies text self-conditioning, task selection, or a neural mechanism. The anchor comparison is answer-first minus reasoning-first. Reasoning text is not evidence of faithful internal computation; nonempty text does not establish substantive reasoning. A null result or perfect accuracy does not establish equivalence. No scientific pass threshold, outcome-dependent sample extension, or post-hoc selection by initial correctness is applied.
failure_policy: Any returned invalid output is retained and never resampled. Wrong schema, wrong key order, empty required reasoning, or any other returned invalidity causes a technical/output-manipulation failure even if other answers comply. Compliant-subset estimates and bounds in this JSON are audit diagnostics only when interpretation_allowed is false; do not use them to claim a successful manipulation or a revision-order effect.
